basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: A case covering request, eligibility, reverse movement, inspection, disposition and refund.
Differs from a warranty claim, a chargeback or a product recall, though it may link to them.
Keeps refund obligation, instruction, execution and settlement as separate states.
Differs from fulfilment, which moves goods forward.

may: Register a return request with reason and evidence.
Check eligibility rules and propose a remedy.
mustNot: Determine legal eligibility or reject statutory rights.
Authorize returns or refunds without delegation.
Judge item condition or choose disposition.
Execute refunds to a different account than the original payer.
requiresHuman: Disposition of unsafe or recalled goods.

considerations: Consumers have statutory return rights that must not be obscured.
Returned goods may be unsafe and need safe handling.
Disposal of returns has environmental cost.

items: A return case names an original order or item, a claimant, a reason, a remedy and a status.
Often confused with a chargeback, a credit note, a warranty claim or a complaint.
